headline: Sensex, Nifty End Marginally Lower in Diwali Muhurat Trading, Snapping Seven-Day Winning Streak

marketStatus.message: Today is Diwali Laxmi Pujan. NSE will conduct Muhurat Trading. Exact trading timings are notified separately by NSE.

why: Sensex and Nifty ended marginally lower during the special Muhurat trading session, breaking a seven-day rally.
Bharti Airtel and Infosys featured among the top losers, dragging indices down.
Nifty closed below the 25,000 level in the Diwali session.
Pharma and metal stocks registered gains despite the broader market closing slightly in the red.
whatHappening: BSE and NSE conducted Muhurat trading on Diwali, marking the start of Samvat 2083.
Indian equities ended in the red on Diwali day for the first time in eight years.
Prior to the Muhurat session, Indian stocks had posted their best week in six years.
Kalpataru CFO reiterated confidence in meeting the Rs 6,500-crore pre-sales target for FY27 amid strong home demand.
summary: Indian stock markets ended marginally lower during the Diwali Muhurat trading session, ending a seven-day rally. Bharti Airtel and Infosys were key drag factors, while pharma and metal stocks gained. Investors are now looking toward Monday's session for further direction in Samvat 2083.
